title: Bayesian Calibration of Win Rate Estimation with LLM Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the deviation between LLM evaluators' observed win rates and true human preference win rates, and using Bayesian inference methods (Bayesian Win Rate Sampling and Bayesian Dawid-Skene) to calibrate and mitigate these estimation errors.

Evaluating and mitigating the effect of the order in which compared texts are presented to the LLM judge by employing a swap-and-sum strategy, which queries the model twice with original and swapped orderings and sums the scores.
